description: This source file defines the LogView class, which is a custom Android TextView used to display log data received via the LogNode interface. It formats log messages with priority, tag, message, and exception details, and appends them to the view.

classes.name: LogView
classes.description: A custom TextView that displays log messages formatted according to their priority, tag, message, and exception details. Implements the LogNode interface and chains to the next LogNode.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Formats and outputs a log message to the LogView. Converts priority to a string, processes exception stack traces, and ensures UI thread safety.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: appendIfNotNull
methods.description: Helper method that appends a string to a StringBuilder with a delimiter if the string is not null or empty.

methods.name: appendToLog
methods.description: Appends a log message as a new line in the LogView.
